measured_on.note: Same binary, library and config are required for the tolerances below to mean anything. A different MYDS_CHUNK_KEY_MAX moves throughput by several percent on its own (ledger 105.7).

tolerances.why: tps_pct covers thermal and page-cache drift between sessions on the same machine (observed run-to-run spread within one session was 0.135%). gain_pp is wider because it is a difference of two such numbers. prompt_tok_pct is loose on purpose: the frozen corpus tags differ from the historical per-run nonces, so exact token equality is not expected; a drift beyond 2% means the corpus or the tokenizer changed.

fixed_sample.claim: the two arms must produce identical bytes on this sample; the absolute sha is recorded for cross-check, not as a requirement

gpu.claim: both arms must be saturated; if one arm sits far below 95% residency the comparison is invalid rather than fast

invariants.why: a non-zero cached row did no prefill; identical encoded counts would mean the arm switch never took effect; a fallback means the candidate declined to run, so the arm measured the reference path

l3_smoke.why: a single-arm, single-boot smoke run of the shipped harness, kept so the numbers quoted in ledger 106.5 are checkable rather than asserted. It is NOT an A/B result: one arm, one boot, two timed samples.
